note: Trained on S1+S2+S3 (SignSage captures) plus S4, the external ISL reference videos (one clip per word, mixed signer(s) and sources). No held-out data exists for this exact model. Expected quality estimated by train S1+S2+S4 / test S3 (5 seeds): acc 0.980 +/- 0.029, macro-F1 0.979 +/- 0.030 (see results_s4_videos.json); baseline S1+S2 / S3 was 0.935 +/- 0.012.

trained_on.s4_note: S4 = external reference videos (hello, help, me, no, rest, water, where, yes, you), 1 clip/word, converted with the same tasks-vision landmarker models as the app.

exclusion_reason: Weak on S3 (F1 0.52 and 0.44 in the 10-class model).
signer_note: adapted to one signer; not signer-independent
model: 1D-CNN (cnn-v3), dropout 0.3: Conv1d(122->32->64, ReLU, Dropout) x2, AdaptiveAvgPool1d, Linear->n_classes. Trained WITH frame-level augmentation (hand-frame dropout 0-50%, scale +/-10%, rotation +/-10 deg, time-warp +/-15%).

features.normalisation: MediaPipe Left/Right labels IGNORED. Hands assigned to two stable physical slots by temporal tracking (nearest wrist to previous frame; two hands in one frame ordered by image x, then continuity). ACTIVE slot = hand with larger total wrist travel (tie: more frames present); other = SECONDARY. Per-frame: wrist - shoulder_centre / shoulder_width; other 20 landmarks - wrist / hand_size (hand_size = ||wrist - middle fingertip||). If the active hand's mean wrist x is image-left of the shoulder midpoint, all x coords (hands + face) are mirrored about the per-frame shoulder midpoint so the active hand is right-hand-active. Missing runs <=5 frames interpolated; longer/leading/trailing missing kept as zero coords with mask=0, never normalised into shoulder space.

extractor.name: @mediapipe/tasks-vision PoseLandmarker + FaceLandmarker + HandLandmarker
extractor.note: External ISL reference video converted with the same tasks-vision landmarker models as the app/recorder (Python tasks API, CPU delegate). Different signer(s)/sources; coordinates NOT mirrored; handedness follows the image.

fps_note: Features resampled to 60 frames per clip (uniform subsample if T>=60, edge-pad if T<60). S4 reference videos are 25-30 fps; app captures are ~10 fps; the model is invariant to this via resampling. Coordinates are NOT mirrored; canonicalisation mirroring is applied inside features_v3.
threshold_note: Threshold 0.7 kept from REPORT_G (calibrated on S2 dev); not re-selected from S3. Train S1+S2+S4 / test S3: acc 0.980 at 100% coverage; threshold table in results_s4_videos.json.

s3_heldout_metrics.note: from results_s4_videos.json (train S1+S2+S4, test S3, 5 seeds)

golden_test_vector.note: Run features_v3/sign_features_v3 on golden_test_vector.npy then the model; logits must match expected_logits (within float tolerance).
